notes: SITE: NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced (Williams-Sonoma UK) with Searchspring (siteId mrb1uc) rendering all facet-browse grids client-side via bgfilter.ss_hierarchy; captured via Playwright network interception of the mrb1uc.a.searchspring.io/api/search/category.json XHR (tier 2; tier 1 curl alone could not see this client-rendered request/response, but the endpoint itself is a plain JSON API confirmed reachable directly by curl too). No Claude-specific robots.txt disallow found. SALE VS CLEARANCE (the critical distinction): the site's own top nav/footer separates two sibling sections under 'Sale': (1) 'Sale' > 'Autumn Sale' > 'All Sale' (hierarchy 'Sale>Autumn Sale>All Sale', homepage banner literally reads 'Autumn Sale IS HERE! Save up to 50% on furniture & more', totalResults=752) - this is a temporary seasonal promotional campaign and was EXCLUDED entirely, not included in this file; and (2) 'Sale' > 'Clearance' (hierarchy 'Sale>Clearance', page H1 'Clearance', totalResults=512) with 12 further genuine site-defined children (Furniture/Garden/Rugs & Curtains/Bed Linen/Bath/Lighting/Cushions & Throws/Room Decor/Art & Mirrors/Kitchen & Dining/Christmas/Baby & Kids Clearance), each its own canonical URL and its own distinct ss_hierarchy leaf under 'Sale>Clearance>...'. These 12 plus the 'All Clearance' parent are recorded below as the genuine Clearance PLP structure. Also found /sale-sale/clearance-save-50-or-more ('Save 50% or More', totalResults=299) - its ss_hierarchy is 'Sale>Save 50% Or More', a SIBLING of Clearance directly under 'Sale', not a child of it, and its own label carries no clearance/outlet/final/end-of-line wording - a generic percent-off discount cut across the whole Sale area, not a clearance/outlet listing per the site's own taxonomy, so EXCLUDED (not ambiguous enough to need a flag - the hierarchy placement and generic wording are both clear). QTY: every category.json response on this site's facet-browse template injects exactly 2 non-product marketing banners into merchandising.content.inline (verified data-banner-type='image', e.g. an Autumn Sale promo banner and a PayPal banner) which are counted inside pagination.totalResults; the -2 offset was directly proven on a single-page listing elsewhere on this site (New Furniture: totalResults=68, actual results array=66, exact match) and confirmed to be a one-time injection (page 2 of a multi-page listing carried 0 banners / a full 72 real results), so qty = totalResults - 2 throughout. Sum of the 12 children (555) exceeds the All Clearance parent total (510) - expected overlap (a product can sit in more than one clearance sub-section, e.g. Kitchen & Dining items also appearing under a cross-cut node), not an error, consistent with the brief's overlap allowance.
